description:
Activate Tormod's Crpyt by tapping and sacrificing it, exiling your graveyard.
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Deadbridge Chant triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat from step 2.
NOTE: This combo can fail if other cards enter your graveyard after step 1.
